programme.title: Hua Hee Everyday
programme.desc: Malaysia's highest-rated Hokkien sitcom, Hua Hee Everyday is back with a hilarious new season, plus the introduction of new characters. Kim Shui's son, Ah Huat falls in love with Xiao Yu, an ice-kacang seller who poses a threat to his grandma's kuih stall. But he is encouraged by his father to follow his heart. Despite a successful career, Bee Hong again puts her marriage at risk by succumbing to temptation. Spurred on by their online business with Ban Ji Beng, Pearl and Rou Wan contemplate taking their relationship to another level. And just when Pek Hun finally sees some light at the end of the tunnel in her struggle to conceive, new issues arise to throw everything into disarray. Join Kim Shui, his family and his friends in overcoming adversities through optimism and determination!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi watches along to clips of his top 10 favorite episodes about his love for construction adventures. Countdown with him to number 1!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Join Gecko for some of his ultimate rescue missions! Blue must face his fear of a storm to save Eric the Excavator, who is stuck in a trench with a dam about to overflow! Then, Weasel fits Vicky the Ice Cream truck with a super-fast rocket, causing her to speed out of control! Gecko and the Mechanicals must stop her before she crashes. From saving a trapped Mummy Truck to rescuing the Mechs, it's always a big adventure!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: It's a big day of teamwork and fixes at Gecko's Garage! When the Mechanicals accidentally injure Gecko's foot, they must learn the value of teamwork to finish repairing Bobby the Bus by themselves. Then, when Green Mechanical gets stressed, Gecko teaches her mindfulness tips to calm down. The teamwork continues as Gecko helps his rival, Mr. Weasel, fix an engine with a clean electric one, and the whole crew works together to repair Trevor the Tractor's giant gears!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on a sense-ational journey! He visits a garden to discover his five senses, exploring the flavors of fruit and colors of flowers. His nature-filled day continues at a gorgeous greenhouse where he plants a seed and learns how water, nutrition and sunlight help plants grow. He names all the colors and learns about flowers, picking a beautiful bouquet.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi learns all about bowling in this episode featuring the great indoors. There's always fun to be had even when the weather doesn't cooperate and Blippi knows just how to find it! Blippi learns the proper way to roll a bowling ball and how to knock down the pins for a strike!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Spend a whole day with JJ, from morning to night! Wake up and get ready with the family as JJ learns his morning routine. Then, it's off to a big adventure: JJ's first day of preschool! He's a little nervous, but he makes new friends and has lots of fun. After a full day of playing, it's time to get ready for bed. Mommy guides JJ through his nighttime routine of brushing his teeth, taking a bath and reading a story before he drifts off to sleep.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ and his friends for a fun school day at Melon Patch Academy! Ms. Appleberry finds exciting ways to learn, like using building blocks and drawings to practice the alphabet. Then, the kids play a fun guessing game to learn all about the five senses and how to sign them in ASL! The learning continues as they sing about the days of the week, play a fun alphabet photo game on a rainy day and enjoy story time with the whole family. It's a day packed with learning and fun!

programme.title: Mia's Magic Playground
programme.desc: Welcome to Mia's Magic Playground! Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Mia's Magic Playground
programme.desc: Welcome to Mia's Magic Playground! Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: Suspended from the team, Shakes uses the time off to investigate his father's disappearance on Mt. Kilimanjaro. While evading a mad snowboarder and an avalanche, Shakes can't help but monitor his teammates' every move from afar.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: In a last-ditch effort to stay in the running for the final, Coach drops his team in the Amazon for some wild training. Shakes is amped, but El Matador isn't himself. Who is he?! And what does a mysterious photographer have to do with it?

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: All set to play Iron Tank for a place in the final, Supa Strikas can't resist a no-rules pick-up game aboard a massive tanker. But when an uninvited guest steers the ship towards disaster, will they rise above rivalry and work together?

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for an amazing day at Amy's Playground! First, he explores the colorful playground while learning all about his colors. Then, Blippi shows us the importance of stretching before we learn about lunges, push-ups and more fun exercises! The amazing day ends when Blippi meets a balloosionist, who teaches him how to make different things out of balloons, such as rainbows, dogs and even a life-size balloon version of Blippi himself!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on a prehistoric adventure! He's visiting an incredible dinosaur exhibition to learn all about these magnificent creatures from the past. Blippi gets to see giant dinosaur skeletons, look at lifelike models, and learn the names of different dinosaurs, from the mighty T-Rex to the gentle Brachiosaurus. It's a dino-mite journey back in time!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John on some big day out adventures! First, the family visits the zoo to see all the amazing animals, like elephants, monkeys and hippos! Then, it's Baby John's first time at the water park, where he has lots of fun with water squirters and wading pools. The adventure continues with a trip to a fun theme park, where the family enjoys the merry-go-round, bumper cars and yummy cotton candy!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get ready for some bath and bedtime fun with Baby John! First, Baby John is a little scared to try swimming, but his family is there to show him just how easy and fun it can be! Then, it's time for a bath. Bathtime has never been so exciting, as Baby John has fun learning his colors by matching different colored bath sharks to their hoops. Finally, it's time to get ready for bed with a fun story and a cozy cuddle.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: It's time for Meekah to get crafty with some DIY and design! First, she visits the Nailed It! DIY Studio where she flexes her crafting skills and creates her own project. Meekah learns to nail wood together, sand it down smooth and then paint it with a roller and stencils! Then, she visits Playday where she gets creative and learns about her personal style and basic fashion design. She designs an 'M' for her shirt and crafts a new accessory!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a big animal hug challenge! First, Blippi and Meekah visit Farm Sanctuary, the perfect place to make friends with animals. They get to feed animals who are all different sizes, from big steers to small donkeys. Then, on another visit, Meekah learns that cows LOVE to be hugged! She wonders what other animals enjoy hugs and sets out to do a HUG CHALLENGE, where she sees if she can hug 10 animals in a day!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Neither snow nor rain can stop the mail! Blippi is learning all about the journey a letter takes. He visits a post office to see how mail is sorted and then learns about the important job of a mail carrier. It's a special delivery of fun and facts about the postal service.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on some awesome artistic adventures! First, he visits Boise Art Glass, where he looks at beautiful glass sculptures and chandeliers. Blippi then works with an in-house glass blower to create his very own orange and blue bowl! The artistic fun continues as Blippi visits a flying yoga studio to learn how to dance in the air! Using a silk, he learns tricks and dance moves from an aerial dance instructor.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some challenging situations! When Fuse gets a birthday present of a skydiving ticket, he's too proud to tell Bubbles he's scared of heights and tries to face his fears. Then, Zee is cupcake crazy! When he discovers Bubbles is running a cupcake factory out of her house, he finds it impossible to control himself. The challenges continue when Newt crashes one of Fuse's fishing expeditions and turns out to be a natural!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into some magical situations! Pogo is bored, so when he discovers a genie in a magic lamp who grants three wishes, he uses them to try and get his friends in the mood for fun. Then, Jeff wants to impress his friends with his hors d'oeuvres, but he is upstaged by Zee, who has a secret ingredient. Finally, Zee accidentally gets on Bubbles' rescue mission to stop a meteor storm and his surprising talent may be just what she needs!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on a dino rescue mission! First, he wants to learn about baby dinosaurs at Dinotropolis. He meets a Pterodactyl with eggs in her nest and plays with the cute baby dinos that have already hatched! Then, it's a play day at Blippi's clubhouse! Join him as he crosses a rainbow bridge, plays in a ball pit and helps return lost dinosaur eggs to their nests.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's another brand new Blippi adventure for kids! Today Blippi visits Great Explorations Children's Museum in St. Petersburg, Florida. What do you want to be when you grow up? A chef? A vet? A doctor? Learn with Blippi as he teaches your children about different careers and jobs for kids.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a fun day at Jumper Jungle indoor playground! On a day of sporty play, Meekah finds different sports balls, including a basketball and a soccer ball. As she collects them, she searches for the best place to play each sports game. Then, it's a day of bouncy play! Join Meekah as she bounces around the inflatable play structures and bounces like a bunny, frolics like a frog and hops like a hare!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah on a magic dragon quest! First, she exercises her body and mind at an indoor playground with a fun matching game. She explores a Doctor's Office, Fire Station and a huge ball pit! Then, Meekah travels to a medieval-themed playground. She meets a Knight and follows dragon footprints through an enchanted castle, climbing walls and sliding down a donut slide to find adorable baby dragons!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready for a delicious pizza pie adventure with Blippi! First, he stops by the play supermarket inside Billy Beez to buy all the ingredients he needs to make a tasty pizza. Then, Blippi learns how to make an authentic Italian pizza from a real pizza-maker! He goes on a scavenger hunt for veggie toppings, makes the dough from scratch and cooks his handmade pizza in an outdoor wood oven. So cheesy good!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? Join Blippi as he explores different, exciting occupations through play! At the Children's Museum of Idaho, he discovers what it's like to be a pilot and a veterinarian. The exploration continues at the Hawaii Children's Discovery Center, where he does a 'special report' on even more jobs! He reads the news like a TV anchor, drives a fire truck and sorts letters like a mail carrier.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The Insectibles are split into two desperate missions! Plus, Fuse gets a new job as a delivery man.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a tough day! It's Jeff's birthday, and everyone is in party mode except Jeff. His strict rules and regulations threaten to derail his own celebrations! Then, Newt decides that Zee is unfit and is in need of some much-needed fitness training, but he's not interested. Finally, after a mishap on a hot air balloon trip, Pogo and Jeff find themselves stranded on a desert island!

Grab your supplies and draw along with Blippi and Meekah!

programme.desc: It's time to learn all about planes with Blippi! First, he's at Erin Air in Seattle, WA, and he's ready to explore a private jet! After learning about the different types of planes and making sure everything is good to go, it's time for takeoff! Then, Blippi visits another airfield to learn even more about planes! Blippi soars high above the city while taking a plane ride and then sings the popular Plane Song!

She's ready to explore, but she's hungry for a snack, so she travels the various playlands looking for one. Then, Meekah explores another indoor playground, where she encounters different emotions. She uses fun puppets to demonstrate what her emotions 'look like' and 'feel like.'

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a bouncy day of sports and play! First, she jumps and plays her way through Sky Zone Trampoline Park. She climbs play structures, goes down slides and even tests her ninja skills in the ninja course! Along the way, she meets some special dino friends! Then, Explorer Meekah searches for shapes and learns about the different balls used in sports. She goes around the indoor playground discovering new ways to bounce, roll and dunk them!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready for a delicious pizza pie adventure with Blippi! First, he stops by the play supermarket inside Billy Beez to buy all the ingredients he needs to make a tasty pizza. Then, Blippi learns how to make an authentic Italian pizza from a real pizza-maker! He goes on a scavenger hunt for veggie toppings, makes the dough from scratch and cooks his handmade pizza in an outdoor wood oven. So cheesy good!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi and Meekah as they get curious about science! They embark on an environmental science scavenger hunt through the Explorit Museum, learning about pollination, wind and solar power. Their curiosity continues as they build and test their own cars to see how fast they can go, even constructing a big city for their vehicles to drive in!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into trouble! Slick sees Bubbles' talent for invention and decides he wants in on it, too. But after several failures, he takes a shortcut and 'borrows' one of her ideas, to disastrous effect! Then, Pogo makes himself homeless while playing a reckless game and is kindly taken in by Fuse. But it's not long before his prank-playing becomes insufferable. Plus, Bubbles discovers a possibly cursed ancient artifact.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some challenging situations! When Fuse gets a birthday present of a skydiving ticket, he's too proud to tell Bubbles he's scared of heights and tries to face his fears. Then, Zee is cupcake crazy! When he discovers Bubbles is running a cupcake factory out of her house, he finds it impossible to control himself. The challenges continue when Newt crashes one of Fuse's fishing expeditions and turns out to be a natural!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi as he visits the Seattle Children's Museum for a day of community-themed fun! He gets to explore a miniature city and learn about all the different jobs that help a community run, from firefighters to doctors. It's a fun and educational adventure that shows how everyone has an important role to play.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi goes on a scientific learning adventure! He heads to the Mount Wilson observatory to learn about all the cool things we can see in our night sky. From stars to moons to distant planets, learning about space is out-of-this-world cool! His journey continues at Wonderworks Science Museum when all of a sudden, oh no! The lights went out! So Blippi learns all about light and electricity. He goes through tunnels, plays both giant and regular pianos and even makes a shadow puppet show with his hands!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Is Meekah up for the ultimate dance challenge? When her Dino Buddy wants to be a musician, Meekah takes her to a music studio to create a song and learn about counting beats. Then, she learns the foundations of gymnastics, like how to do a forward roll and walk on the balance beam. Finally, she visits an awesome indoor playground, where she plays a fun game where she has to dance her way to each of the different play areas!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: It's Monster Jammin time with Meekah! First, she watches a skid steer challenge a monster truck to a donut challenge! This gives her a great idea to use her Wonder Watch to shrink the trucks and have her own mini Jam. Then, it's a dancing scavenger hunt as Meekah digs her way around a construction site to see her favorite trucks on the move. As she follows Blippi's construction truck map, she creates a dance by watching each vehicle work.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi is ready to make a splash! He has fun at Aquatica Park, learning water safety from a lifeguard and trying out amazing water slides including a rainbow one. He continues his day of water play at Yas Waterworld, experiencing fast slides and splishing and splashing through the park. Blippi also makes new animal friends at NatureWorks as part of his day of discovery!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi becomes a scientist for the day! His adventure begins at Mighty Coders where he learns how to build and communicate with machines through coding even making an airplane model move. Afterwards he visits an imagination museum exploring concepts like gravity through jungle gyms and pendulum exhibits and discovers that even big block towers can fall!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate baby dino daycare! Park Ranger Maisie's efforts to record a commercial for her new pet-sitting service are thwarted by an escaped T-Rex! Then, the hatching of a baby Brachiosaurus melts hearts inside Dino HQ. But the Dino Master challenges Park Rangers Orson and Wyatt to a dangerous game of Hide 'N Seek, while the other rangers try to manage the rambunctious newborn Brachiosaurus and T-Rex!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Get ready for awesome new gadgets and Robo-Girl! When Orson asks the Park Rangers to come up with new dino gadgets, Asher effortlessly comes up with dozens, while Sam struggles to come up with one of her own. Then, Asher's new dino remote control gadget might be a game changer, but first he has to work out the kinks. Sam comes to terms with her origin as a Dino Master invention and helps save the day with her awesome Robo-Girl powers!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Get ready to solve a super dino mystery with the Park Rangers! First, Maisie, Bella and Asher travel to the mysterious Dino Spiral to figure out what's inside their last un-hatched egg. But a series of three increasingly difficult trials means they may never find out! Then, when Asher accidentally turns a rogue raptor invisible with the Dino Master's invisibility cloak, Masie and Bella swoop in on the upgraded T-Rex 1 to help save the day!

Plus, a pleasant afternoon barbecue takes a turn for the worse for Jeff.

programme.desc: Get ready to make learning fun with Blippi! In this exciting adventure, Blippi visits DEFY Trampoline Park in Tumwater, Washington. It's an energetic day of jumping, playing and learning!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-quiet night in Oddsville! When a power cut strikes, all the Oddbods seek refuge at Fuse's house, ruining his plans to watch the big game. Then, a funky asteroid lands in the cul-de-sac and emits groovy pop music that puts everyone in a dance trance! The chaos continues when one of Newt's eggs gets zapped at the store and hatches into an adorable but monstrously hungry chick!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a wild day! An incident with Newt and some local birds causes the accidental launch of Bubbles' rocket into space with the birds inside! Then, Fuse feels excluded when all his neighbors become engrossed in a new 'Pokebod' game on their phones and constantly put themselves in danger. Finally, Pogo prides himself on being a master of the prank and sends Bubbles on an elaborate goose-chase into the snowy mountains.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Get ready for an action-packed day of battling evil robots and racing villains! First, the new and improved Robofreeze becomes faulty, and Mila and Morphle must help Officer Freeze retrieve the remote to turn him off! Then, it's time for the Pet Port Rally, but naughty Winston cheats by using sneaky devices to slow everyone down. The chaos continues as two Robofreezes turn evil and multiply, and a lightning strike turns another one into a super-powered menace!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Welcome to the wacky world of Winston and Orphle! First, Winston tricks a Magic Pet into growing his robots of Mila and Morphle big enough to steal the entire Magic Pet Center! Then, Orphle causes trouble on his own when he runs away with the cake Mila made for her and Morphle's Matchiversary. The two troublemakers team up to try and get their hands on a special surprise gift, but it's up to Mila and Morphle to stop them!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble and other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. But the wacky problems don't stop there! When a ghost crashes playtime, Arpo has to use all his tech to bust it. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably and when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo and Baby Daniel are causing chaos all over town! The adventure starts at the supermarket when Daniel runs off with a giant lollipop, leading to a wild chase with Arpo's rockets on the fritz. Then, a relaxing fishing picnic turns into a wilderness survival test when a thieving squirrel tries to steal their food! Plus, the family gets a mischievous new puppy that Arpo has to keep from making messes and a stroller goes on the loose, forcing Arpo to chase it through town!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Time for some indoor fun! Blippi is sharing his top 10 favorite visits to amazing indoor playgrounds. Relive the excitement as he explores giant play structures, jumps in colorful ball pits, and zips down super-fast slides. It's a high-energy collection of his most memorable indoor adventures.

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi watches along to clips of his top 10 favorite episodes about dinosaurs. He roars, stomps, wiggles, and giggles his way through all things dinosaur! Countdown with him through egg hunts, fossil digs, and dinosaur chases...ROARRRR!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: It's a big day of teamwork and fixes at Gecko's Garage! When the Mechanicals accidentally injure Gecko's foot, they must learn the value of teamwork to finish repairing Bobby the Bus by themselves. Then, when Green Mechanical gets stressed, Gecko teaches her mindfulness tips to calm down. The teamwork continues as Gecko helps his rival, Mr. Weasel, fix an engine with a clean electric one, and the whole crew works together to repair Trevor the Tractor's giant gears!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: The ultimate rivalry between Gecko and Mr. Weasel heats up! After a big rainstorm, Weasel challenges Gecko to a head-to-head car wash competition. Then, Weasel decides he wants a Mechanical of his own, so he hatches a scheme to try and steal Gecko's secret plans! The rivalry continues as Weasel tries to show off his new sports car but gets stuck, and his automated car wash mistakes Weasel for his car!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi as he journeys over the waves in search of dolphins! He learns about operating a boat and protecting the water for the amazing animals that live there. Afterwards, Blippi's bike gets a flat tire, so he and Meekah visit the Spoke Bicycle Cafe to fix it. They learn about bike wheels and decorate helmets before hitting the road for an amazing bike ride.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready for some vroom vroom vehicles! Blippi wants to learn how to do a donut, so he visits a Monster Jam track to learn from an expert. Then, it's time for the Super Silly Speed Race, but first, he goes to the US Formula 1 Grand Prix to learn from the pros before he competes for first place.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's time to learn the fundamentals with JJ! Join him and his friends as they practice their numbers by counting baby chicks with Grandpa and singing about five little monkeys jumping on the bed. Then, it's time to learn about colors! Watch as the kids paint plain toy cars with a splash of color and help Ms. Appleberry mix primary colors with jello to make secondary colors. From learning shapes to making yummy rainbow popsicles, this adventure is full of learning fun!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a guide to staying healthy and happy! The learning starts with hygiene, as JJ and his friends learn the importance of washing their hands and how to scrub-a-dub-dub in the bath. Then, it's time for some big milestones! Sing along as JJ learns to use the potty and TomTom learns what happens when you lose a tooth. Plus, join the Melon Patch kids as they visit the doctor for a checkup and learn that it's nothing to be afraid of!

How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: It's time for Blippi to get curious and creative! A mysterious book appears in the clubhouse, and when Blippi opens it, the brand-new Curiosity Crew jumps out! They learn all about how to mix colors to make a beautiful rainbow painting, shrink down to dance with Bendjamin the Klutz and ride a library cart on a hunt for books about dinosaurs!

The day gets even stranger when Newt finds a four-leaf clover and has an amazing run of good luck!

programme.title: The Commando
programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agent's home.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: High school teenagers accidentally unleash an ancient Irish entity on their hometown and must stop it before midnight on Halloween.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: A South African gold mine foreman is unwittingly manipulated by an unscrupulous gang of financiers who want to flood the mine to raise the price of gold on the world market.

programme.title: The Trouble With Spies
programme.desc: A third-rate British spy is sent to an island, unaware he is there to lure Soviet spies.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: The Coca Cola Kid
programme.desc: A smug sales executive treks to Australia to improve regional sales and becomes embroiled in sexual and professional shenanigans.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: What You Wish For
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck chef with gambling problems flees to a Latin American villa to join a team of chefs who cook for the super rich. He soon gets more than he bargained for when he discovers the dark secrets of his employer's unique and dangerous culinary appetite

programme.title: The Legion
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Peter Five Eight
programme.desc: Sam, a seemingly poised and glamorous real estate agent in a small mountain community is revealed to be an unhinged and troubled alcoholic with a dark secret, when a charismatic man in a black sedan named Peter shows up in town one day.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Hospitality
programme.desc: A woman with a checkered past must protect her son when a man brings trouble to her isolated bed and breakfast.

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: A somewhat mentally handicapped 20-year-old man works as a laborer, but everyone abuses his naivety. A nice 40-year-old American woman hires him one day and they become close. However, the town and his family see her as predatory.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Juvenile
programme.desc: Troublemaker Billy Forsetti falls for the beautiful Jennifer. But when a carjacking takes a turn for the worse, Billy finds himself in for trouble.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: High Voltage [Extended Version]
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor's life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: Ann (Heather Graham) is a yoga teacher struggling to achieve inner peace despite the fact her family is driving her crazy and her dating life is miserable.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: The Legion [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: No One Lives
programme.desc: A gang of ruthless highway killers kidnap a wealthy couple traveling cross country only to shockingly discover that things are not what they seem.

programme.title: Locked In [Extended Version]
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: Ann (Heather Graham) is a yoga teacher struggling to achieve inner peace despite the fact her family is driving her crazy and her dating life is miserable.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: The Legion [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: No One Lives
programme.desc: A gang of ruthless highway killers kidnap a wealthy couple traveling cross country only to shockingly discover that things are not what they seem.

programme.title: Locked In [Extended Version]
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: The Commando
programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agent's home.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: High school teenagers accidentally unleash an ancient Irish entity on their hometown and must stop it before midnight on Halloween.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: A South African gold mine foreman is unwittingly manipulated by an unscrupulous gang of financiers who want to flood the mine to raise the price of gold on the world market.

programme.title: The Trouble With Spies
programme.desc: A third-rate British spy is sent to an island, unaware he is there to lure Soviet spies.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: The Coca Cola Kid
programme.desc: A smug sales executive treks to Australia to improve regional sales and becomes embroiled in sexual and professional shenanigans.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: What You Wish For
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck chef with gambling problems flees to a Latin American villa to join a team of chefs who cook for the super rich. He soon gets more than he bargained for when he discovers the dark secrets of his employer's unique and dangerous culinary appetite

programme.title: Fast Favs
programme.desc: For a quick and tasty meal, chef Spencer Watts cooks up fast favs using scallops and trout, all done in under 30 minutes.

programme.title: Fruit
programme.desc: Chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts mixes the sweet flavours of fruit with fish as he makes dishes with salmon and scallops.

programme.title: Dairy
programme.desc: Seafood and dairy make the perfect partners. Watch as Chef Spencer Watts creates some dairy-infused dishes using red snapper and scampi.

programme.title: Tart
programme.desc: Chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts makes tastebuds dance as he creates recipes that combine sour and tart flavours with grouper and clams.

programme.title: Energy Boost
programme.desc: Food nerd Desiree Nielsen masters a perfectly cooked eggplant topped with a flavourful charmoula and couscous.

programme.title: Veggies Galore
programme.desc: Desiree Nielsen shows how beets can make the icing on a delectable cupcake vibrant and delicious.

programme.title: Duck Wing Delight & Rum Coolers
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are serving up a BBQ menu packed with bold spices, sweet flavours, and creative combinations. They sear blackened scallops with avocado corn relish, glaze duck wings with raspberry chipotle sauce, pair them with smashed potatoes and mushrooms, and cool down with honeyed watermelon salad and a rum cooler.

programme.title: Italian Brussels Sprouts & Hickory Turkey Legs
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are taking BBQ comfort food to the next level with smoky favourites and sweet surprises. They grill Brussels sprouts with pancetta, truffle, and parmesan, smoke hickory turkey legs with a sweet and spicy black bean salad, and finish with grilled fruit treats.

programme.title: Chinese-ish
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from an award-winning cookbook: Chinese-ish by Joanna Hu and Rosheen Kaul! Follow along as Shahir makes fried rice fit for a billionaire, Australian-inspired shrimp toast, comforting chicken soup, and much more!

programme.desc: Rice Balls Stuffed with Seafood and Pistachio Cannoli are on the menu as Chef Michael Bonacini explores dishes from the Italian island of Sicily.

programme.title: Lettuce Eat Lasagna
programme.desc: Desiree Nielsen shows how salads can be a tasty main AND served warm with a grilled romaine salad.

programme.title: Apples and Anchovies
programme.desc: In an "A" challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas makes apple fritters and fried anchovies. But how will she combine these distinct flavours in the same dish?

programme.title: Lombardy
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini prepares traditional dishes from the Northern Italian region, Lombardy.

programme.title: Cashews and Carrots
programme.desc: Chef Lauren Gulyas tests her imagination with cashews and carrots. First, she makes cashew chicken and carrot cupcakes. But how will she combine them?

programme.title: Salty
programme.desc: Meaty prawns and melt-in-your-mouth cod are on the menu as trendy chef and seafood expert Spencer Watts gets a little "salty" with seafood.

programme.title: Cassoulet
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: Carrot Cake
programme.desc: Who said dessert couldn't come before dinner? In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui serves up a hedonistically hard-to-beat Carrot Cake, made extra-moist with applesauce and tons of cream cheese icing. Micah Trainor ditches dessert and heads for the healthy option - a Cider Poached Chicken Waldorf Salad full of pecans and cinnamon for that classic cake flavour. Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: Trentino-Alto Adige
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Molise
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Valle D'Aosta
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Lazio
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Campania
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Emilia Romagna
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Calabria
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Lombardy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Umbria
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Sardegna
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Friuli Venezia Guilia
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
programme.desc: The ultimate childhood comfort food, Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup! Missy Hui takes this dish up with a basil- infused tomato soup that's ubERS-creamy and fresh! Don't forget the grilled cheese - gooey Havarti, provolone, and cheddar ooze out of this sandwich for an ultra-indulgent dish. Tiera Singh's twist on toast and tomatoes? Panzanella Salad! Ripe, seasonal tomatoes are tossed with a tangy capERS-vinegar dressing that is soaked up by crunchy croutons. Going higher? Micah Trainor's Seared Halloumi and Glazed Fruit grills the cheese - no bread needed! Seared halloumi is topped with bourbon-glazed fruit for a savoury-sweet vegetarian dish. Poppy Sandler's Lobster Roll with Sweet Corn Bisque brings back the soup and sammie - Up the Dish style. Roasted corn cobs add a complex note, and homemade jalapeno mayo brings the spice!

programme.title: Veal Piccata
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: Salmon Salad Niçoise
programme.desc: How many ways can salmon be prepared? Up the Dish is on a mission to find out! Tiera Singh's Salmon Salad NiÃ§oise is a staple of the French Riviera with shallot, eggs, and haricot verts, but she swaps out the tuna for luxuriant olive oil poached salmon - it may not be traditional but it sure tastes good! Poppy Sandler smokes the competition with a buttery Smoked Salmon Omelette, garnished with fresh chives and earthy goat cheese. Next, Micah Trainor skips the salmon but keeps the veggies for her steamed Tofu Nori Dim Sum Dumplings, with tart gingERS-pickled shallots and tons of green goodness. Missy Hui has the big finish; her Salmon with Béarnaise is cooked sous vide for a precisely cooked fish dish and served alongside Pommes Anna for a plate that's straight out of Paris.

programme.title: French Onion Soup
programme.desc: Onions, cheese, bread, soup, four elements that live in harmony, especially in this episode of Up the Dish! Poppy Sandler starts off in Paris - classic French Onion Soup with sweet, caramelized onions and melty Comte cheese, with perfect rounds of toasted baguette. Poppy passes it over to Micah Trainor, who doesn't miss a beat; her Tenderloin Roast with Sherry Braised Shallots is sweet, savoury, and bursting with flavour. Tiera Singh takes a chive-y dive into the vegetarian side with her Chive Pesto Pasta - don't worry, the pesto is totally customizable! Missy Hui has the showstopper, Scallion Ash Carrots and Parsnips, and it's a five-star treatment that takes the simple to spectacular! Sous-vide carrots and turnips are sprinkled with sweet-savoury scallion ash for a strangely satisfying dish.

programme.title: Dairy

programme.title: Tart

programme.title: Ceviche
programme.desc: Host Tiera Singh goes on a South American tour with Peruvian Ceviche. Marinated citrusy seabass and shrimp swim in a sea of sweet potatoes and creamy avocado - it's hard to beat! But Poppy Sandler takes a shot, and lands on Grilled Shrimp with a smoky charred Corn and Avocado salad, topped with garlic and lemon grilled jumbo shrimp. Next, Missy Hui indulges her sweet tooth with Vegan Key Lime Tarts. Her trick? Using avocado for extra cream and extra green. Branzino with Shishito and Mango is how Micah Trainor scales it up - her whole-fish-dish is pan-roasted and spiced with chaat masala, topped with mangoes and blistered shishito peppers for a five-star feast!

programme.title: Paella
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, steal away to Spain for a summer vacation as host Tiera Singh takes a swing at Paella, complete with sunny saffron, saucy sofrito, and super crunchy soccarat. Next, Missy Hui takes a break for brunch with Chorizo Eggs Benedict - the Saffron Hollandaise is good as gold and twice as bright! Poppy Sandler follows with her Fritto Misto and Sofrito, a delicate and fresh veggie fry-up that soaks up a tomato-spiked sofrito dipping sauce. Micah Trainor finishes up with restaurant-ready Razor Clams steamed in sparkling Spanish wine, served alongside nutty Iberico Ham and sweet Manchego cheese.

programme.title: Coq au Vin
programme.desc: Up the Dish goes French cuisine with Poppy Sandler's classic Coq au Vin! Slow-cooked chicken in a luscious red wine sauce with pearl onions and mushrooms on the side? Yes please! Tiera Singh sticks with the tricolour theme and makes a Salad Lyonnaise - crispy bacon, poached eggs, and homemade croutons, with a red wine-bacon vinaigrette that steals the show. Missy Hui stays on the continent but skips la Republique; her Vincotto Mushrooms with Lentils uses an Italian wine to sauce up meaty oyster mushrooms and aromatic vegetables for a vegetarian twist. But Micah Trainor takes us right back to France - her Rabbit Rillettes with Champagne Gelee is white tablecloth worthy, with rabbit confit cooked in duck fat and fresh berries in a sweet champagne gelee, too good to eat... almost!

programme.title: Sashimi
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-raw deal in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Poppy Sandler sets things in motion and slices up a simple, elegant Sashimi with tangy Ponzu and tart Wasabi Mayo on the side. Missy Hui gets carnivorous with Lamb Carpaccio and Dukkah - delicate raw lamb and a Middle Eastern-style dip served with some delicious pita! But wait, what's a vegetarian to do with all this meat? Tiera Singh's got the answer - island-style Poke Bowls, with fruit instead of fish. Refreshing watermelon is marinated in a savoury, soy-based sauce and served with rice. For the finale, Micah Trainor Up('s) the Dish with her Scallop Tartare and Beet Chips, combining raw scallops with ultra-decadent truffle oil and sour cream.

programme.desc: In this fast-paced episode, host Theresa Visintin uses two unlikely ingredients that start with the letter "G," garbanzo beans and grapefruit! First up, Theresa cooks socca, a savoury garbanzo bean pancake recipe, and infuses it with Mediterranean flavours. To make her batter, Theresa combines chickpea flour with salty olives, sweet red pepper, and fresh basil. Once the batter is ready to go, she fries the savoury crepe. Next up, Theresa balances tart grapefruit with a sweet buttery lobster tail. But that's not sweet enough for Theresa! She prepares sabayon, a delicate honey custard that melts in your mouth. Finally, Theresa shows us how to make a mouth-watering dish by combining grapefruit and garbanzo.

programme.title: Chicken and Corn

Next, she transforms corn into a creamy polenta topping for her Shepard’s pie...with a twist! Sautéing onion, garlic, and lean ground beef, she uses Worcestershire sauce and tomato paste to give the pie filling an extra flavour boost. Once she finishes those dishes, Chef Lauren creates a mouth-watering recipe that combines both chicken and corn.

programme.title: Less is More

programme.title: The Butter Did It
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: Job Well Done
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs make hot dog pasta and test kitchen hacks, Liam whips up crunchy chicken katsu, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make scrumptious French toast casserole, and more!

programme.title: Japanese food inspired by other cultures
programme.desc: Chef and culinary instructor Hana Etsuko Dethlefsen shows us Japanese cuisine inspired by other cultures with a pork and tofu dish, sesame chicken salad, breaded pork cutlet, and even a French crepe.

programme.title: Fried Rice
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: Popular Japanese Noodles
programme.desc: Noodles are the star ingredients when chef Hana Etsuko Dethlefsen cooks up somen noodles with dipping sauce, ramen salad, a fried noodle dish, and a one-pot delight.

programme.title: Sashimi
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-raw deal in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Poppy Sandler sets things in motion and slices up a simple, elegant Sashimi with tangy Ponzu and tart Wasabi Mayo on the side. Missy Hui gets carnivorous with Lamb Carpaccio and Dukkah - delicate raw lamb and a Middle Eastern-style dip served with some delicious pita! But wait, what's a vegetarian to do with all this meat? Tiera Singh's got the answer - island-style Poke Bowls, with fruit instead of fish. Refreshing watermelon is marinated in a savoury, soy-based sauce and served with rice. For the finale, Micah Trainor Up('s) the Dish with her Scallop Tartare and Beet Chips, combining raw scallops with ultra-decadent truffle oil and sour cream.

programme.title: UNDERGROUND
programme.desc: These six homes take underground living to the extreme. To make their subterranean dreams a reality, the homeowners must follow expert advice—and dig deep into their pockets to build below the surface.

programme.title: POINT PLEASANT THE MONSTER PROPHECIES
programme.desc: In a rooftop showdown, a family fights the Spottsville Monster, eerie phantoms haunt tornado survivors, and New Jersey fishermen encounter a gigantic bug.

programme.title: DEADLY MEDICINE
programme.desc: When the death rate at a rural Indiana hospital skyrockets, an investigation implicates a nurse, Orville Lynn Majors. State Police are left with a daunting task. In order to conclude that Majors is a serial killer, police first have to first figure out if the deaths were murders and then determine how he killed the patients. A two-year, $1.6 million investigation ends with the arrest of Majors on seven counts of murder. With the statistical evidence that spawned the investigation barred from court, prosecutors Greg Carter and Nina Alexander will have a difficult time convincing the jury of Majors’ guilt, and putting an end to his deadly medicine.

programme.title: WATERFRONT
programme.desc: These homeowners are chasing waterfront dreams—ocean, lake, or lagoon. The views are worth it, but wild weather, unstable ground, and tough construction make the journey just as challenging as the destination.

programme.title: THE MISSING SHOWGIRL
programme.desc: Debbie moves to Vegas to be a showgirl, meets a Cirque performer, and lands a solo. But her body is found in cement, unraveling a tale of deceit and betrayal.

programme.title: FATHER'S PAIN
programme.desc: When a mother and her infant daughter disappear from rural Huntsville, Texas, suspicion quickly falls on the woman’s husband. Lacking evidence, authorities cannot make an arrest. With the case growing cold, a teenager hundreds of miles away confesses to the murder of Margaret and Kori Rae Owings. Prosecutor David Weeks builds a capital murder case around the confession, but defense attorneys argue that it was illegally obtained. It will take the United States Supreme Court to decide whether an admitted murderer will go free.

programme.desc: When a mother and her infant daughter disappear from rural Huntsville, Texas, suspicion quickly falls on the woman’s husband. Lacking evidence, authorities cannot make an arrest. With the case growing cold, a teenager hundreds of miles away confesses to the murder of Margaret and Kori Rae Owings. Prosecutor David Weeks builds a capital murder case around the confession, but defense attorneys argue that it was illegally obtained. It will take the United States Supreme Court to decide whether an admitted murderer will go free.

programme.title: HIDDEN ROOMS
programme.desc: There’s more than what meets the eye as homeowners across America take you inside their mind-blowing hidden rooms. Blending wild fantasy with modern luxury, brilliant architects tackle challenging requests to make their clients’ dreams come true.

programme.title: HOLLYWOOD HORROR
programme.desc: Linda, a swimsuit model and ex-Raiders cheerleader, vanishes after a desert shoot. Police find a twisted trail leading to a killer with a sinister secret.

programme.title: DEADLY FIXATION
programme.desc: On Memorial Day Weekend 1996, a woman’s body is discovered in a storm drain in Marietta, Ohio. Police eventually identify the woman as college student Sheree Petry and begin to focus the investigation on one suspect, Dennis Rydbom, who had been spurned by the victim. But with little evidence, no arrest can be made. When a second search of Rydbom’s residence turns up Sheree’s personal belongings, he is arrested and charged with her murder. With a completely circumstantial case, prosecutors Ginny Conley and Scott Durig have to prove Dennis Rydbom believed that if he could not have Sheree Petry, then no one else would either.
