programme.title: EASIER SAID
programme.desc: Larry wants to drive his1959 Cadillac DeVille, but the car has spent decades baking in the Arizona sun. Brian spent years gathering parts to restore his grandfather’s 1960 Bel Air only to find that he’s missing more critical components than he’s found…

programme.title: DECADES TO DRIVE
programme.desc: Dave traded for his dream 1957 Corvette more than three decades ago, but his plans to build it have so far come to nothing. Ken chose a rare 1954 Kaiser Darrin from his father’s collection and its now on FantomWorks to reverse the hands of time.

programme.title: FALLEN STARLET
programme.desc: Rebecca, a rising actress, is shot on her LA doorstep before her 'Godfather III' audition. Investigators face a puzzling crime scene to find her killer.

programme.title: FLAMES OF RAGE
programme.desc: When firefighters in suburban Indianapolis are called to a house fire, what they find inside shocks the entire community, a respected minister and his wife have been murdered with an ax. An exhaustive investigation leads authorities to a teenage church member and his accomplice. Prosecutors Carole Johnson and Gary Chavers make a deal with the accomplice to testify against his friend, but when the case goes to the jury, confusion over a point of law puts the killer’s possible murder conviction in jeopardy.

programme.title: ONE FOR OLE MISS
programme.desc: Sean asks Dan to find a 1969 Camaro that can be built into the custom restomod of his dreams. Jeff wants to give his 1969 Cutlass a rare Hurst makeover, but the engine has never run and there are more parts in boxes than on the car.

programme.title: LEGACY
programme.desc: Tom asks Dan to find him a rare 1967 Camaro Convertible with factory AC. But when Dan finds the Unicorn, the car is too good to cut up. Dave wants Dan to build a safe, all stock 1971 Datsun, but the car has been badly damaged by previous restoration work.

programme.title: NASHVILLE NIGHTMARE
programme.desc: Aspiring country singer Melissa goes missing in Nashville. Found strangled with her rodeo belt, clues lead to a man who killed her to boost his twisted fame.

programme.title: NORTHSIDE RAPIST
programme.desc: A string of rapes spanning two decades goes unsolved in Jacksonville, Florida, until Detective Diana Clarke finds a link among the crimes and discovers that a serial rapist is terrorizing the community. After a suspect is finally arrested, Detective Clarke teams up with Prosecutor Libby Senterfitt to track down the rapist’s victims and convince them to testify. But facing their attacker in open court proves too difficult for some of the terrified women. Unless prosecutors can convince them to testify, it may be impossible to rid Jacksonville’s streets of a dangerous predator.

programme.desc: A string of rapes spanning two decades goes unsolved in Jacksonville, Florida, until Detective Diana Clarke finds a link among the crimes and discovers that a serial rapist is terrorizing the community. After a suspect is finally arrested, Detective Clarke teams up with Prosecutor Libby Senterfitt to track down the rapist’s victims and convince them to testify. But facing their attacker in open court proves too difficult for some of the terrified women. Unless prosecutors can convince them to testify, it may be impossible to rid Jacksonville’s streets of a dangerous predator.

programme.desc: Sean asks Dan to find a 1969 Camaro that can be built into the custom restomod of his dreams. Jeff wants to give his 1969 Cutlass a rare Hurst makeover, but the engine has never run and there are more parts in boxes than on the car.

programme.desc: Tom asks Dan to find him a rare 1967 Camaro Convertible with factory AC. But when Dan finds the Unicorn, the car is too good to cut up. Dave wants Dan to build a safe, all stock 1971 Datsun, but the car has been badly damaged by previous restoration work.

programme.title: DEATH IN STORE
programme.desc: A robbery and double homicide at a grocery store in Raleigh, North Carolina shocks the community. With little evidence left behind, and no eyewitnesses, the investigation stalls. Then a tip to authorities implicates a store employee in another robbery and leads Prosecutor Evelyn Hill to believe that that employee, and his brother, committed the murders. Using state-of-the-art forensic technology and the testimony of a third brother, Hill hopes to convince a jury of the brothers’ guilt. But the stakes are raised when the defendants attempt to cheat the system, and put themselves back on the streets.

The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for some construction chaos and clever fixes! First, Mr. Rubble is very tired and puts the plans on the board upside down, causing the crew to build a house upside down! Then, while building a roundabout, the crew finds some big old dinosaur bones! The chaos continues as a power cut stops all their machines, so they hook everything up to clean solar panels instead. From building a pond for frogs to building themselves into a box, it's always chaotic!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join Digley and Dazey as they face the biggest, craziest disasters! First, a big thunderstorm hits while the crew is working, and they have to rescue Scout after she gets trapped down a hole! Then, while working on a railway bridge, an earthquake causes it to almost fall apart, and the team must fix it before a train crosses! From escaping an avalanche they accidentally caused on a mountain to helping a baby lion that has escaped from the zoo, it's a day of big disasters!

The chaos starts when Robot creates a jelly-making machine, but it goes haywire and he ends up stuck inside a giant wobbly jelly! Then, Princess Cat puts way too much soap in her washing machine, causing it to overflow and fill her entire castle with bubbles! From a wobbly tooth to a picky eater, it's one funny problem after another!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Join Kii and Yii for songs about feeling good and staying safe! First, learn the best way to get a healthy smile in a fun and educational song about how to brush your teeth properly. Then, learn how to be safe when you're riding a bike at the playground. The lessons continue as Kii and Yii sing about being kind to each other, especially when a friend is sick. From learning colors to singing a soothing lullaby, these songs will make you feel good!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get ready for a month of learning! Join Baby John on his first day of preschool and see how sharing toys makes everything more fun. Learn to count with a magic potato show and match colors with a brand-new train. It's a big adventure!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Play and learn at school this month! Get your face painted like your favorite animal and put on a puppet show. Build your own bus, play a funny face game, and discover the letters of the alphabet in an exciting game with Mom.

programme.desc: Join a month of fun and learning! Go to the petting zoo and lead a group of chicks, then play musical chairs at school. Take your first ballet class, build a crazy bubble machine, and go on an adventure to a prehistoric fantasy land!

Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool and discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders

Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors and why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.desc: Celebrate the joy of music with the Melon Patch teachers! Learn about different instruments, move your body to the beat, and listen to the sounds of nature. Discover how you can use music to express yourself through hands-on, playful fun.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Get ready for JJ's Learning Month! Feel excited for your first day of school, learn your ABCs with blocks, and discover your five senses. Go on a field trip to see ten baby chicks hatch and take a fun ride on the big yellow school bus!

programme.desc: Make some music this month! Form a rock band at school, sing your ABCs with alphabet soup, and help find five little duckies. Solve the mystery of the missing buses and learn that even a tough day can be a wonderful one with good friends.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns all about being safe! First, he learns how important it is to always put on his seatbelt when he goes for a ride. After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley and Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger and sillier, and after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet and sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It'!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate teamwork and rescue special with Kii and Yii! The adventure begins when Princess Cat is flying her plane but gets in a sticky jammy mess, causing her to lose control! It's up to Kii and Yii to get her down safely. Then, the friends are playing near Princess Cat's castle when she accidentally falls down the well and needs to be rescued again! From helping Humpty Dumpty to rounding up runaway vegetables, Kii and Yii always save the day!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready to laugh as everything goes hilariously wrong for Kii and Yii and their friends! The chaos starts when Robot creates a jelly-making machine, but it goes haywire and he ends up stuck inside a giant wobbly jelly! Then, Princess Cat puts way too much soap in her washing machine, causing it to overflow and fill her entire castle with bubbles! From a wobbly tooth to a picky eater, it's one funny problem after another!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: What should Baby John be when he grows up? Join him as he explores different fun jobs! First, it's race day for Baby John and Manny! They each choose a vehicle to test on the racetrack: an ice cream truck against an ambulance! Then, it's superhero day at daycare, and Manny arrives in a luchador outfit. Everyone is curious, so he explains that luchadores are Mexican superheroes! The fun continues as Baby John drives a bus and picks up friends dressed in different professions.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John on a big animal adventure! First, the family takes a tour of the farm, where the farmer shows them all sorts of amazing animals. Then, Jill finds a little lost lamb, and with the help of her siblings, they adventure around the farm to find the lamb's mommy. The animal fun continues as the family visits the zoo to learn about opposites with help from the loud lions and quiet turtles!

programme.title: The Speed record
programme.desc: MewMew has a new stopwatch and wants to time everything that everyone does, to get to them to do it at record speed. Life in Abra-Dabra becomes intolerable as everyone tries to be quicker than the next person. Eventually Deedee and the others persuade MewMew to break all his speed records. When he achieves it no one applauds him, so MewMew realises that many things are better done in their own sweet time. He also realises that by doing everything fast, he is missing out on enjoying many things.

programme.title: Doobydoo Meep Concert
programme.desc: The annual Doobydoo Meep concert is about to take place, and Charlie wants to practice one last time before heading out. So Deedee chips in by agreeing to follow specific instructions to organise the difficult to manage Doobydoos but also promises not to use magic for anything at all. Deedee mixes up the sandwiches for the Doodyboos with the recorders that she ends up sending off with Mewmew. Nino constantly keeps Deedee in check so that she doesn’t back out of her promise. Mewmew is having a tough time organising with the Doobydoos while Deedee finds out Charlie has slept of practising. The concert goes well, but they all decide they won’t have lullabies ever again.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!nThey are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Love Barista
programme.desc: Superstar Jun-woo is stranded in Vietnam with no passport and money. Barista Tao breaks his phone and offers him shelter. As their bond begins to blossom, scandals tear them apart...

programme.title: Dark Nuns
programme.desc: A boy is possessed by an evil spirit and his life is at risk. 2 nuns embark on a dangerous ritual and are determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences.

programme.title: Miss Fortune
programme.desc: Swindler Ji-Hye is looking to make her last big score. Together with her daughter, they infiltrate the house of a cultural property broker with a net worth of 60 billion won.

programme.title: Peninsula
programme.desc: Set four years after the zombie outbreak, a former soldier and his team return to the zombie-infested wastelands to retrieve a truck of money and try to escape from it alive.

programme.title: Handsome Guys
programme.desc: Self-proclaimed tough guy Jae-Pil and sexy guy Sang-Gu move to a countryside home. A spirit sealed in the basement awakens, leading to a high-stimulus chilling comedy they'll never forget.

programme.title: Decision to Leave

programme.title: Most Haunted - S18:E05 - Carr House

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E78 - Voyage Into The Sun
programme.desc: For the first time in history, NASA’s Parker Solar Probe has pierced the Sun’s corona and is orbiting above its surface. Scientists have a front-row seat to better understand the sun and predict huge solar eruptions that can cause serious damage when they hit Earth.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E67 - Ocean Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A team of scientists embarks on a quest to explore the mesopelagic zone or ocean twilight zone which sits beneath the surface layer of the ocean and stretches around the world. This mysterious region just might hold the key to climate change and the planet’s future.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E58 - The West Is Burning
programme.desc: How did the western United States become a hotspot for unwieldy and devastating forest fires? Learn how the history of forest management and loss of public trust, coupled with climate change, have led to the conditions driving mega-fire nearly year-round.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E91 - Engineering Life
programme.desc: Humans are not the strongest. Our senses are nothing special. But our intelligence is letting us wield the power of evolution. Scientists are unlocking the mysteries of the natural world to improve our lives, our health and our future.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E10 - The Sound Of Science
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds.Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they tune into the science behind sound. This week’s experiments hit high notes as we discover the physics of theremins, investigate how the outer ear impacts human hearing, and put on a laser show with cymatics.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E09 - Don't Believe Your Eyes
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they make science look like sorcery. This week’s experiments delve into the possibilities of mind control, why objects and people tend to sync together, and the magical mysteries behind magnesium.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E06 - Hot Hot Heat
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they turn up the thermostat and discover the role heat plays in science. This week’s experiments investigate how to send secret messages with heat.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E05 - Up and Atom
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they break open the atomic bonds that connect our world. programme.title: Wardens - S06:E03 - Illegal Possession
programme.desc: Montana U.S.A. Region 3 Wardens chase down a check station runner, only to find the hunters have shot a deer.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E04 - Under Fire
programme.desc: The drought conditions in Montana U.S.A. threaten to close down hunting and fishing in the Treasure State. But, dead fish and restrictions are the least of the Wardens worries when the bears come to town.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E01 - The Last Frontier
programme.desc: Join filmmaker Casey Anderson as he embeds in the Alaskan wilderness to follow the largest terrestrial carnivores in the world. Every fall in the northern Pacific, up to a million salmon migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born to spawn. Many of these streams are located in Katmai National Park, Alaska. It’s here where a massive population of coastal brown bears gather to eat these fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E02 - Fish Like A Bear
programme.desc: Join filmmaker Casey Anderson as he embeds in the Alaskan wilderness to follow the largest terrestrial carnivores in the world. The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish. Along their path, they have an intimate encounter with a mom and her three cubs. They arrive at their destination and see many bears that they have already met as well as some new faces.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E03 - A Working Ecosystem
programme.desc: Everyone hates biting insects, but if you look closer you can see that even the tiniest and most irritating bug can be essential for a working ecosystem. During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E04 - The Wolf and the Storm
programme.desc: After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts. They encounter a familiar bear family on their way and decide to follow them to a local fishing spot where a large number of bears have gathered.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E05 - Masters of Attack
programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E06 - Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Animals can employ a number of different defenses in order to withstand an attack. Some seek safety in herds, some hide in plain sight, some meet aggression with even stronger aggression, and some build fortresses. Whatever the strategy it is clear that animals will do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E02 - Fastest
programme.desc: The fastest? The explosive sprinting cheetah? The mighty kangaroo? The horned and leaping wildebeest? The powerful and sure-footed horse? Or the swift-footed pronghorn? Which is the fastest over land?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E03 - Biggest
programme.desc: The Biggest? An Elephant? A Giraffe? A Hippopotamus? Or the humpback whale which is three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighs more than a dozen hippos. But which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E04 - Smartest
programme.desc: Are animals smart? You bet. But which is the smartest of them all? The socially complex chimpanzee? The inventive bolas spider? The architectural termite? The curious dolphin? Or the inimitable octopus?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E05 - Strongest
programme.desc: How do you decide which is the strongest animal on the Planet? Wild Ones looks at the comparative strength of the tiniest of ants to that of a might grizzly bear, or a deadly crocodile to the indestructible rhinoceros.
